text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I talked to my family yesterday,
and they
shared their happy qi with me!
choice_data_list: You're full of energy, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
My dad and I talked a bunch about feng
shui, and
my mom seemed as happy as
ever!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And my little brother... Well, he still
didn't seem
very interested in feng shui,
but he sounded fine,
so that was nice!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
My two youngest sisters were acting like
royalty, giving my middle sister a
headache with all their
demands for
stuff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Copano Rickey had a
great time on
her day off!
